description.en: Separate private TaskId prototype evidence from a targeted active-compiler regression checkpoint, including opaque identity, the 16-byte Task descriptor, ownership and worker lifecycle boundaries.

contract.task_id: Opaque Copy diagnostic data with a private serial; no source field constructor, integer conversion, address conversion, native owner token, or OS thread ID.
contract.uniqueness: Nonzero monotonically issued identities within one linked runtime instance; failed creation may leave gaps. Slots, Scope closure, consumed observation and JIT invocations do not recycle identities.
contract.exhaustion: The last serial is issued once; later construction reports SpawnError.Overflow without wrapping.

task_storage.observation_consumption: Only the first observation word is cleared; the stored identity survives try_take consumption.

contract.native_abi: Identified prepare operations return observation, uninitialized storage and diagnostic serial in one transaction; legacy prepare entry points remain wrappers.
contract.ownership: Task remains move-only and retains its Scope loan. A copied TaskId grants no Task, Scope, result-storage or cancellation authority.

private_prototype.boundary: Ignored private overlay and standalone programs; these results are not evidence from the later active compiler binary.

active_targeted_checkpoint.scope: Five new Task identity gates and Task AIR/JIT preparation plus related Task, Scope, Cancellation, Closure, Shared, Sync, Memory, dynamic-interface, array and basic-type regressions.

limits: The 40-test active checkpoint is targeted coverage, not a completed 143-test full-suite run.
AArch64 and x86-64 layout contracts were checked; execution in this checkpoint ran on local macOS ARM64. It does not establish Linux or Windows execution.
macOS LeakSanitizer is unavailable. ASan instrumentation and explicit live-resource counters provide separate evidence; no LeakSanitizer success is claimed.
Preserved JIT module residency is module-level ctor/dtor retention, not a newly implemented per-Control resource-tracker pin.
Full CPU library completion and the separate pending Task features are not implied by this checkpoint.
